en: Vintage black‑and‑white (with light sepia tone) postcard view of a hillside street lined with ornate early‑20th‑century buildings. On the left stands a large multi‑storey school building with towers and steep roofs, connected to the street by a stairway and railing. On the right are substantial bourgeois villas with balconies and decorative façades. Printed red text along the top identifies the location and the school.
